triage_records.title: An Overview of Systematic Reviews of Ginkgo biloba Extracts for Mild Cognitive Impairment and Dementia
triage_records.relevance_rationale: The paper is an overview of systematic reviews specifically evaluating Ginkgo biloba extracts for the prevention of cognitive decline, MCI, and dementia. It directly addresses the queried exposure (Ginkgo biloba) and outcome (cognitive decline/dementia) by synthesizing existing high-level evidence, concluding that while efficacy for MCI/dementia is supported, the question of preventing cognitive decline remains open. This makes it a highly relevant synthesis for the specific research question.

triage_records.title: The Effects of Standardized Ginkgo Biloba Extracts (GBE) on Subjective Cognitive Decline (SCD) in Middle-Aged Adults: A Review
triage_records.relevance_rationale: The research question specifically asks about the prevention of cognitive decline or dementia in 'healthy older adults'. The candidate paper focuses on 'Subjective Cognitive Decline (SCD)' in 'Middle-Aged Adults'. SCD is a distinct clinical entity (self-reported complaints with normal objective testing) and the population (middle-aged) differs from the target population (older adults). Furthermore, the paper is a review of treatment effects on SCD, not a study on the prevention of objective cognitive decline or dementia in healthy older adults.
